QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Riena Strait
QuestInfo.0:
Feng asked Lan Yi, the Beggar Guild member in Victoria, for a job that could provide good combat experience, save some lives, and make the Xuanshan School look good in order to spread its name.
Talk to Lan Yi to learn more about what's going on in the Riena Strait.
QuestInfo.1:
The glaciers in the Riena Strait are melting at an alarming rate, leading to many who live there to lose their homes. You understand all too well what it means to lose the only home you know of.
Talk to #p1201000# at #m140000000# to learn what you can do to help.
